title: Grafana
descript: Grafana is the open observability platform: query, visualize and alert on metrics and logs from Prometheus, Loki, InfluxDB and many other data sources. This package runs the official Docker Hub image as a non-root container (uid 472) and keeps dashboards, plugins and the SQLite database in the application data folder.
important: First run: open the web UI and log in with admin/admin, then change the password. Data lives in /Volume1/DockerAppData/grafanadocker/ and survives restarts and updates. The container runs as uid 472, so mounted folders must be readable by that user. Needs DockerEngine; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Back up the application data folder before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

github.description: The open and composable observability and data visualization platform. Visualize metrics, logs, and traces from multiple sources like Prometheus, Loki, Elasticsearch, InfluxDB, Postgres and many more.

zh-cn.descript: 指标可视化与监控面板，支持 Prometheus 等数据源。
zh-cn.important: 首次使用请打开网页完成初始化。数据保存在 DockerAppData/grafanadocker，重启和升级不会丢失。容器以 uid 1000 运行，挂载目录需对该用户可读。需要 DockerEngine；Docker Hub 不可达时先配置镜像加速。卸载并删除数据前请备份。局域网内为 HTTP。
